body.description: User to be edited. It finds the user with username.

scope.description: The scope of the user. If it's 'system', it can access system-level stuff. If it's an application name, it can access application-level stuff.

additionalProperties.description: Holds app -> scope of access data. After 2.9.1 users can have multiple app access with different access types.

appNameUserType.description: Holds app -> scope of access data. After 2.9.1 users can have multiple app access with different access types.

newPassword.description: The new password of the user

firstName.description: The first name of the user

lastName.description: The last name of the user

fullName.description: The full name of the user

picture.description: The URL of the user's picture
